CRITICAL REGISTRATION: retain the EXACT FULL ORIGINAL 2:3 canvas composition. Do NOT crop, reframe, center, zoom, move, rotate or resize the subject relative to the canvas. Keep the original LARGE EMPTY SPACE ABOVE HER HEAD (hair begins around 23% of canvas height), her face around 33% of canvas width and 30% of canvas height, and the dress reaching to the bottom and right boundaries, exactly as photographed.
